_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Data_NPCGiftTastes.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).
